title: Quant bricolage weekly capture - Feb 21 2028
content:
Week snapshot
Date range: 2028-02-14 -> 2028-02-21
Purpose: rapid capture of field observations from the quantization + evals onboarding work for the new compact variants; actionable follow-ups for next sprint. This is intentionally messy — notes-to-self + handoffs.

High-level summary
- Focus: iterate on 4-bit and hybrid 4/8 quant profiles for 'rhino-13B-compact' and 'rhino-7B-lite' while validating on the sprint eval suite.
- Progress: stable inference builds landed for 4/4-bit symmetric and asymmetric flows on CPU fallback nodes; KV-prefetch hook prototype validated locally.
- Risk: small but consistent quality drift on multi-turn factuality subset when using 4-bit+KV-prefetch combination; need targeted eval slices and prompt-level triage.

Experiments run this week
1) q4_sym_smallbatch_v2 (rhino-13B-compact)- config: symmetric 4-bit, per-channel scale, no quant-aware activation clipping- infra: dedicated minibatch size 1 with continuous batching turned off for latency parity- perf: median latency 132ms/token on a p4d-sim node; approx 3.1x cheaper than fp16 baseline per-token cost- quality: avg Rouge-L down 1.8 pts on summarization slice; hallucination metric +5% on open-qa slice- notes: good for tail-cost reduction but needs reprojection on attention outputs; suspect quantization noise amplifies across KV reuse

2) q4_hybrid_kvtest (rhino-13B-compact + kv-prefetch)- config: embeddings and FFN in 8-bit, attention + KV in 4-bit; KV-prefetch enabled with 2-step lookahead- infra: microbatching 4 (microbatch pipeline enabled), experimental scheduler on dedicated pool- perf: throughput +18% vs q4_sym_smallbatch_v2, latency p95 increases by ~9% when KV cache warmups overlap with other requests- quality: small regression on multi-turn coreference tests; fails in 12/240 cases where pronoun resolution ties to earlier context >512 tokens- notes: KV-prefetch reduces cold-start cost but interacts badly with quant noise; need to test with per-layer rescaling before KV write

3) control_fp16_tune (baseline)- baseline metrics collected end-to-end for comparison- perf: median latency 410ms/token, stable correctness baseline- quality: expected on all evals, used for delta analysis

Eval results and triage
- Regression suite: sprint-eval-suite-v3 (includes safety-regression-suite-v2, factuality-slice, summarization-longform, multi-turn-coref)
- Key regressions flagged:
  - factuality-slice: precision drop when using q4_sym_smallbatch_v2 on sources with tabular inputs; likely numeric rounding in attention softmax logits
  - multi-turn-coref: as above, interacts with KV-prefetch; 5% absolute increase in pronoun-resolution failures
- Approach to triage:
  1) Re-run failing examples with attention logits dumped (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/probe/pull/402) to inspect numeric divergence window
  2) Try per-layer scale factors for attention output before KV write; can be toggled at runtime with flag '--kv-rescale'
  3) Add prompt perturbation tests to see if small changes amplify failure probability (random token insertions at context boundaries)

Infrastructure and infra-ops notes
- Build: landed qruntime-v0.9.7 on dev cluster; includes asymmetric quant kernel and safer fallback path that raises usage logs when per-token variance exceeds threshold
- CI: added smoke test that runs a 10-sample multi-turn conversation through q4_hybrid_kvtest before merge to reduce regressions reaching main branch
- Observability: added token-level divergence traces to the console for models marked 'experimental-compact' (still gated behind feature flag)

Open questions / brainstorms
- Is KV-prefetch beneficial at scale for bursty traffic patterns when combined with 4-bit quant profiles? Hypothesis: wins on steady state but amplifies noise on interrupted sessions. Need production trace sampling from dedicated pool.
- Can we do a tiny post-quantization calibration pass on attention keys/values only (3-5 batches) using unlabelled in-proc tokens to reduce drift? Risk: extra cold-start overhead.
- Should model-onboarding checklist include a mandatory 'kv-stress' eval slice for any model that will use KV-prefetch? Looks like a necessary addition.

Action items (owners)
- Maya: prepare attention-logs run and upload to PR for 20 failing examples by Tue Feb 22 (blocked: need larger disk in dev cluster — ticket PROBE-936)
- Arjun: prototype '--kv-rescale' knob and run on q4_hybrid_kvtest; report perf/quality delta by Fri Feb 25
- Lena: add kv-stress slice to sprint-eval-suite-v3 and create synthetic cases that extend context > 1k tokens; patch due Wed Feb 23 (JIRA:PROBE-920)
- Tomas: check CI flaky test that started failing after qruntime-v0.9.7; investigate and roll forward fix or revert if high risk
- Priya: capture production traces for a dedicated pool to measure cold/warm KV-prefetch behavior; coordinate with SRE for sampling window (SRE ticket SRE-1184)

Meeting notes and decisions from sync (2028-02-18)
- Decision: continue with hybrid 4/8 profile exploration but gate rollout behind passing kv-stress slice and per-example attention-log review
- Agreement: add guardrails in runtime to disable KV-prefetch automatically if per-token divergence > threshold within first 8 tokens of context
- Follow-up: set up a canary on a low-traffic customer that already uses dedicated pools; contact solutions-eng to propose a short pilot (owner: Maya + Solutions Eng)

Loose ends / housekeeping
- Update onboarding doc for compact variants with notes about extra eval slices and the '--kv-rescale' flag once it lands
- Ensure feature flags for experimental-compact are documented in product/console accordion so PMs can toggle in partner demos

Attachments / links
- link to failing examples and dumped logs: github.com/redwood-inference/probe/issues/402#attach- not public yet; PR includes artifact uploads
- JIRA tickets referenced: PROBE-914, PROBE-920, PROBE-936

Quick wins for next 72h
- Short-run per-layer rescale test for attention outputs (Arjun)
- Add cold-start KV-prefetch smoke test into presubmit (Tomas)
- Create 30 synthetic long-context coref cases and add to kv-stress slice (Lena)

Notes to self
- When copying eval slices into Confluence, keep raw examples next to the measurements so reviewers can eyeball the exact prompt that regressed; useful for small teams doing rapid triage.
- This doc is intentionally stream-of-consciousness — will tidy into a proper postmortem if regressions persist after fixes.

End of capture 
Maya C.
